spans.s:
लप् {c1c} P. (लपति)
1 To speak,
talk in general.
--2 To prate, chatter.
--3 To whisper; कपोलतले मिलिता
लपितुं किमपि श्रुतिमूले

.
--4 To wail,
lament. --Caus. (लापयति-ते) To
cause to talk &c. WITH उद् to call
out loudly to.

लपनं [लप्-भावे ल्युट्]
1 Talking,
speaking.
--2 The mouth.

लपित p. p. Spoken, said,
chattered &c.
--तं Speech, voice.

लप्सिका A kind of prepared
food.

लापिका A sort of enigma or
riddle.
